description: This file defines the MBLanguage class, which manages language strings, templates, and related operations for module language management in the SuiteCRM project. It handles loading, merging, saving, and translating language and application list strings, as well as managing language template configurations.

classes.name: MBLanguage
classes.description: Class responsible for managing language strings, templates, and translations within SuiteCRM's Module Builder framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MBLanguage object with the module name, path, label, and key name.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads language strings and initializes internal structures.

methods.name: loadStrings
methods.description: Loads language strings from files within a directory into internal storage.

methods.name: loadAppListStrings
methods.description: Loads application list strings from files within a directory.

methods.name: generateModStrings
methods.description: Generates the module strings by loading language files from templates and directories.

methods.name: getModStrings
methods.description: Retrieves merged language strings for a specified language.

methods.name: getAppListStrings
methods.description: Retrieves merged application list strings for a specified language.

methods.name: generateAppStrings
methods.description: Generates application-specific language strings from templates and directories.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the language strings and application list strings to files, with options to duplicate or rename.

methods.name: getGlobalAppListStringsForMB
methods.description: Includes global application list strings into MB-specific language files if options are set.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Copies language files to a target path.

methods.name: loadTemplates
methods.description: Loads language templates from the module's config.php.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates a label into the specified language if available.
